column1: # Tab-separated so it needs no parser, no API and no account: `fkt` fetches this
# one static file from the default branch and matches it against the installed
# VERSION. Nothing is sent anywhere — the request carries no identifiers, and no
# response is recorded beyond the cached copy of this file.
#   introduced  first affected version, or - if every earlier version is affected
#   fixed       first fixed version, or - while unfixed
#   url         advisory link, or - if there is none yet
# Advisories are published here even for users who have turned update checks
# off; see docs/security-model.md. Publishing one is a deliberate, reviewed act
# — this file is not a changelog.
